profile.headline: PeopleSoft Applications and Technology Senior Consultant
profile.summary:
I have over 25 years of PeopleSoft experience, including 5 years of Enterprise Development experience with PeopleSoft Inc. I have extensive experience in all phases of the development lifecycle including requirements gathering, functional design, technical design, development, testing, performance tuning, and support. I am capable of performing multiple roles including technical development, functional analysis, data analysis, and PeopleSoft system administration. I possess a unique combination of PeopleSoft enterprise development and real-world IT experience. Above all, I have a great combination of positive attitude, teamwork, and work ethic! I really enjoy what I do and it shows in my work and professionalism.

I have 8 years experience as a freelance developer on a variety of platforms including Django, Python, Shopify, and GCP. I specialize in integrations between systems using a variety of integration technologies.

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed modifications in Python for Cryptocurrency trading platform hosted in Google Cloud
• Developed Shopify Site for non-profit fundraising of custom puzzles
• Developed Django backend integration between Shopify and third party fulfillment system hosted in Google Cloud
• Developed Python meeting minutes application integrated with Google Forms hosted in Google Cloud
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Shopify · Django · Django REST Framework · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: PeopleSoft Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description:
• Managed and developed the integrations required to move all manufacturing plants and corporate from PeopleSoft
to SAP using a phased rollout approach
• Frequent data analysis and reporting leveraging SQL on massive data sets
• Managed and developed all areas required to bring two new Mexico based manufacturing plants on to PeopleSoft
• Developed multiple integrations as Toyota moved to an increased use of third-party cloud-based solution for areas
such as Travel and Expense as well as Time keeping and payroll
• Leading the migration from Toyota’s current EIPP (Electronic Invoicing and Payment Presentation) Saas provider to a
new provider (Taulia)
• Completed technical development for the Production Efficiency project at Toyota North America
• Moved core business to corporate standard chart of accounts utilizing custom conversion programs
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · PeopleSoft · Data Analysis · Integration

positions.title: PeopleSoft Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description: Implemented BI Publisher invoicing including email functionality.

positions.title: PeopleSoft Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description:
• Developed a custom production order system integrated with an external planning system
• Migrated existing customization to JD Edwards
• Implemented Engineering Change Order module
• Moved BOM maintenance from Excel to PeopleSoft
• Integrated with several Third Party Logistics systems

positions.title: Senior Architect of corporate Financial Systems
positions.description:
• Held technology architecture responsibility for 15 different corporate applications including PeopleSoft
• Represent corporate systems on the Enterprise wide Technology Steering Board chaired by the CTO

positions.title: PeopleSoft Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description: • Provided consulting services for three customers spanning six PeopleSoft module

positions.title: Senior Developer/PeopleSoft System Administrator
positions.description: • Technical upgrade lead for 7.5 to 8.4 PeopleSoft upgrade

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
• Wrote functional and technical designs and implemented required code changes for five Supply Chain Management
enterprise releases based on strategic business requirements
• Managed ten outside consultants to specialize the Inventory and Purchasing products for PeopleSoft's entry into the
Healthcare market
• Presented Inventory technical sessions at PeopleSoft Connect conferences to an audience of 200 users
